description:
We are looking for a Developer Experience Engineer to help make Agentic Studio easier to build with, adopt, validate, and scale across Engineering, Product, FDEs, Presales, and Partners.
 

This is a hands-on engineering role at the intersection of developer experience, agentic AI, technical enablement, and product validation.
 

You will build sample agents and reference implementations, create reusable patterns and templates, dogfood new platform capabilities, test real-world use cases, and work closely with Engineering and Product to turn what you learn into improvements to Agentic Studio.
 

 This is not a traditional Developer Relations, documentation, or training role. You will be expected to build, experiment, test, troubleshoot, and work directly with the platform.
 

 What You'll Do 

 Build 
 Build sample agents and reference implementations that demonstrate Agentic Studio capabilities.
 Create reusable templates, patterns, and examples for common enterprise AI use cases.
 Build feature validation environments and proof-of-concepts for new platform capabilities.
 Experiment with new agentic patterns, tools, integrations, MCPs, and AI capabilities.
 Turn real-world use cases into working examples that can be reused by Engineering, FDEs, Presales, and Partners.
 Identify opportunities to simplify the developer experience through better tooling, examples, and platform capabilities.
 Enable 
 Help onboard Engineering, FDEs, Product Managers, Presales, and Partners to Agentic Studio.
 Create hands-on technical workshops, demos, walkthroughs, and examples.
 Help teams understand how and when to use different Agentic Studio capabilities.
 Support technical enablement for new features and releases.
 Create reusable technical assets that help teams become productive without requiring direct engineering support.
 Validate 
 Dogfood new Agentic Studio capabilities before and during releases.
 Test new features against realistic enterprise AI use cases.
 Identify usability, technical, workflow, and developer-experience gaps.
 Challenge new capabilities from the perspective of someone actually building agents.
 Reproduce issues and work with Engineering to diagnose and resolve them.
 Provide structured feedback and recommendations to Product and Engineering.
 Help validate whether new platform capabilities are ready for broader adoption.
 Document 
 Create practical how-to guides and technical implementation examples.
 Define patterns and anti-patterns for building agents with Agentic Studio.
 Create reference architectures and recommended implementation approaches.
 Develop technical adoption playbooks for common scenarios.
 Keep examples and guidance aligned with the latest platform capabilities.
 Turn lessons learned from real implementations into reusable knowledge.
 Bridge 
 Work closely with Engineering to communicate real-world developer friction and use cases.
 Partner with Product Managers to validate requirements and feature experiences.
 Work with FDEs to identify recurring patterns across implementations.
 Support Presales with technically credible demos and reference implementations.
 Help translate field and customer learnings into actionable improvements for Agentic Studio.
 
 What You'll Bring 
 2–4 years of software engineering or related technical experience. 
 Hands-on experience building applications using LLMs or generative AI.
 Strong programming skills in Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, or a similar language.
 Experience working with APIs, integrations, and cloud-based services.
 Understanding of modern AI application concepts such as agents, tool/function calling, RAG, prompts, evaluations, and guardrails.
 Ability to quickly learn new technologies and turn them into working prototypes.
 Strong debugging and problem-solving skills.
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
 Ability to explain technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
 A strong bias toward experimentation, learning, and building.
 Comfortable working across Engineering, Product, FDE, and Presales teams.
 Nice to Have 
 Experience building agentic applications or AI-powered enterprise software.
 Experience with MCP, agent frameworks, AI SDKs, or similar technologies.
 Experience creating developer tools, SDK examples, templates, or reference implementations.
 Experience with enterprise applications, workflow automation, or business processes.
 Experience creating technical demos, workshops, or enablement content.
 Familiarity with AI application testing, evaluation, observability, or monitoring.
 Experience working with developer platforms or APIs.
 What Success Looks Like 

Success in this role means making it significantly easier for technical teams to build and adopt Agentic Studio .
 You will:
 Create examples and reference implementations that become starting points for new agents.
 Help FDEs, Engineering, Presales, and Partners become productive faster.
 Identify platform friction before it becomes a customer problem.
 Validate new capabilities against real-world use cases.
 Establish practical patterns for building agents effectively.
 Bring real-world technical feedback back into Engineering and Product.
 Become a trusted technical resource for how Agentic Studio should be used.
 The Role in One Loop 

 Build → Enable → Validate → Document → Bridge → Improve 

You will be close to the real-world usage of Agentic Studio and have a direct opportunity to influence both how people build with the platform and how the platform evolves .
  

 At IFS you will work in a growing, global enterprise software company where informal hierarchies promote simplicity and trust with responsibility. We strive to deepen our expertise by taking on challenging and varying work assignments in a collaborative environment together with committed colleagues.
 With professionalism and a strong customer focus in everything we do, from R&D to Sales and Consultancy, we are proud to serve world-class customers all over the globe with our leading products.
 If you want to change the status quo, we'll help you make your moment. Join Team Purple. Join IFS.
  
 What We’re Offering 
 Salary Range:  $97,000 to $130,000 plus bonus potential
 Flexible paid time off, including sick and holiday
  Medical, dental, & vision insurance
  401K with Company contribution
  Flexible spending accounts
  Life insurance and disability benefits
  Tuition assistance
  Community involvement and volunteering events
  
 We embrace flexibility and hybrid work opportunities to support diverse needs and lifestyles, while also valuing inclusive workplace experiences. By fostering a sense of community, we drive innovation, strengthen connections, and nurture belonging. Our commitment ensures you can work in a way that suits you best, while also engaging with colleagues to share ideas and build meaningful relationships. 
 
 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. VEVRAA Federal Contractor, Equal Opportunity Employer
